title: feat(infiniteHits): support new routing system
body:
This updates `infiniteHits` lifecycle methods to support the new routing system.

I'm not aware of how the new routing system will exactly work, so this behavior needs to be reviewed.

## `getWidgetState` changes

This method ignores previous UI state values. Otherwise, new values gets skipped.

## `getWidgetSearchParameters` changes

This method now also supports highlighting tags.

***

*`getConfiguration` will be removed later to not break everything.*
